text: UPS system 230 V AC: two 100 % units (00BRA10) with static bypass. Each UPS shall carry the full UPS load (turbine control, DCS, SIS, CEMS, telecom) at 0.9 power factor and with a 15 % margin, with autonomy of 60 minutes at rated load (ER-11.05). The UPS input is from the LV main board, the DC input from the 220 V DC system; both units feed separate distribution boards with automatic changeover of the loads that have single supplies.
